title: Parable of the lost coin
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Luke 15:8-10: a woman with ten silver coins loses one, lights a lamp, sweeps and searches until she finds it, calls friends to rejoice; God rejoices over one sinner who repents.

floor.question: In the Good Samaritan, who helped the hurt man?

steps: She had ten coins and lost one.
She lit a lamp and swept.
She searched until she found it.
She called friends to rejoice; so does heaven.
contexts: a child who loses school fees money

board.do: Draw ten coins with one rolled away.

board.say: What did the woman do to find it?

board.do: Wait for the child to say lit a lamp, swept, searched.
Write Luke 15:10: joy over one sinner who repents.

misconceptions.ask: How many silver coins did the woman have before she lost one?

listen_for: She gave up because she had nine more
misconceptions.ask: What did the woman do about the lost coin?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 15:8 and note "until she finds it".

misconceptions.ask: What does the parable of the lost coin teach?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 15:10 for Jesus' own meaning.

listen_for: Hid it and told no one
misconceptions.ask: What did the woman do when she found the coin (Luke 15:9)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 15:9-10 and link it: the party on earth is like the joy in heaven over one sinner who repents.

checks.question: How many coins did the woman have at first?
Whom does the lost coin stand for?
